name: Gen1Recomp
description: Play Pokemon Red, Blue, Yellow and Silver -- and Gold, in beta -- in 3D natively on TrimUI handhelds using Gen1Recomp 0.2.56 and the Dramaless Shape voxel 3D mod. Needs your own US cartridge dump.
author: Carroarmato0

changelog.v0.4.4: Updates to Gen1Recomp 0.2.43 and adds Pokemon Silver. You must import your ROMs again: the engine rebuilds its decoded data, so your games look missing until you pick each one once more. Saves are safe. You now choose the ROM file yourself in the game's file browser. Smaller download, and the launcher puts CPU settings back on exit.
changelog.v0.4.1: Updates the engine to Gen1Recomp 0.1.98: a long run of fixes to Red, Blue, Yellow and Gold. Mods now run in a sandbox. Saves and imported ROMs untouched.
changelog.v0.4.0: Replaces the 3D voxel mod with Dramaless Shape, which this pak may legally redistribute. Download drops from 39 MB to 22 MB. 3D still needs Swap.pak, and is switched from the OPTIONS menu -- the mod's keyboard shortcuts do not work on a handheld.
changelog.v0.3.0: Adds Pokemon Gold, which upstream ships as a beta. Drop a US Gold dump in your Game Boy Color folder and the next launch imports it. Updates the engine to Gen1Recomp 0.1.81.
changelog.v0.2.2: Fixes a crash that stopped the game starting at all on firmware without libmpg123. The pak now carries its own copy, used only when the firmware has none. Thanks to @nicdichiara.
changelog.v0.2.1: Fixes Pokemon Yellow, which could not be imported. A Yellow dump added after Red or Blue is now picked up on the next launch.
changelog.v0.2.0: Now a Tool pak: it appears under Tools, so no ROM folder or stub file is needed. Upgrading from v0.1.0 removes the old Roms folder; delete Emus/<platform>/Gen1Recomp.pak yourself to reclaim ~31 MB. Saves are untouched.
changelog.v0.1.0: Initial release, bundles Gen1Recomp 0.1.77 and the LOVE 11.5 aarch64 runtime.
